title: AARO sends ODNI a false MFR

tellings.quote: When I went to ODNI September 10th of 2025, Kloski was director per ODNI digs

plain: AARO, the Pentagon office that looks into UAP (the government's term for UFOs), sent the Office of the Director of National Intelligence a memorandum for record, an internal note written to document a meeting, and Dylan Borland says that note was false. Borland, who says a top government official told him aliens run everything, tells Michels this as something he dealt with himself, saying that when he went to the Director's office on 10 September 2025, Jon Kosloski was the director. If true, it would mean the office meant to investigate these reports put a false account on paper about him.
